description: This PHP source file defines a class 'FormatWithCompetency' that implements a 'ValueFormatter' interface. The class provides a method 'getFormattedValue' which formats an input value based on a static competencies array in the 'EmployeeLanguage' entity class. The file is part of the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system, specifically within the 'Maintenance' plugin's 'AccessStrategy' for 'FormatValue'.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetency
classes.description: A class implementing the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format competency-related values based on predefined static data.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the competency description corresponding to the input index, or null if not found.
